analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 30.3 has entered oversold territory, but ADX at 55.1 indicates an overheated trend, bordering on exhaustion. The 5-day and 20-day lows are both $0.05, forming a Higher Low pattern, but it's too early to confirm a trend reversal.
